cv_surface_exact_sequence.consequence: The CV presentation canonically specifies Br(Kc)[2] as a quotient of Lc,E, but does not itself choose an identification with the Picard discriminant 2-torsion.
cv_surface_exact_sequence.source: Creutz-Viray, On Brauer groups of double covers of ruled surfaces, Theorem I / Corollary 5.4

exact_missing_structure: A marked transcendental/K3-lattice realization (equivalently an explicit cohomological Kummer/B-field evaluation of one named CV class) that identifies the CV quotient with Hom(T_Kc,Z/2), followed by the primitive K3-lattice discriminant anti-isometry.
rejected_inference: Do not identify the unique isotropic semantic discriminant vector with J2 without computing a CV-side quadratic/B-field invariant and proving compatibility with the K3 discriminant form.

source_locks.cv_surfaces_exact_location: Theorem I; Corollary 5.4; proof of Theorem I
